description: This file defines the AppStatusStore class, a core component in Apache Spark's status monitoring system. It provides methods to access and manipulate application, job, executor, stage, and task data stored in a key-value store, including metrics and summaries. It also includes a companion object for creating live in-memory stores.

classes.name: AppStatusStore
classes.description: A wrapper class providing access to application status data stored in a KVStore, including methods for retrieving application info, jobs, executors, stages, tasks, and metrics.

methods.name: applicationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves application information, may throw if not available.

methods.name: environmentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves environment info for the application.

methods.name: resourceProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves resource profile information.

methods.name: jobsList
methods.description: Returns a list of jobs filtered by statuses.

methods.name: job
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific job by ID.

methods.name: jobWithAssociatedSql
methods.description: Returns job data along with optional SQL execution ID.

methods.name: executorList
methods.description: Returns a list of executor summaries, optionally filtered to active only.

methods.name: replaceExec
methods.description: Replaces executor info, updating GC and app time for driver.

methods.name: replaceDriverGcTime
methods.description: Creates a new ExecutorSummary with updated GC and app time.

methods.name: extractGcTime
methods.description: Extracts total GC time from executor summary.

methods.name: extractAppTime
methods.description: Calculates application runtime based on application info.

methods.name: miscellaneousProcessList
methods.description: Returns process summaries, filtered by active status.

methods.name: executorSummary
methods.description: Retrieves executor summary by ID.

methods.name: activeStages
methods.description: Fetches active stages for live application.

methods.name: stageList
methods.description: Returns list of stages filtered by statuses and with optional details.

methods.name: stageData
methods.description: Returns data for a specific stage ID.

methods.name: lastStageAttempt
methods.description: Retrieves the latest attempt for a stage.

methods.name: stageAttempt
methods.description: Retrieves specific stage attempt data and associated job IDs.

methods.name: taskCount
methods.description: Counts tasks for a stage attempt.

methods.name: localitySummary
methods.description: Returns locality info for a stage attempt.

methods.name: taskSummary
methods.description: Calculates task metrics quantiles for a stage attempt.

methods.name: taskList
methods.description: Returns list of tasks for a stage attempt, with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: executorSummary
methods.description: Returns executor stage summaries for a stage attempt.

methods.name: speculationSummary
methods.description: Returns speculation stage summary for a stage attempt.

methods.name: rddList
methods.description: Lists RDD storage info, optionally only cached.

methods.name: asOption
methods.description: Executes a closure, returning None if NoSuchElementException is thrown.

methods.name: newStageData
methods.description: Constructs a detailed StageData object with optional metrics and details.

methods.name: stageExecutorSummary
methods.description: Returns executor metrics distributions for a stage attempt.
